title: Uncertainty-aware Power System Planning via Gradient Descent
summary: Power system planning models provide important guidance on long-term investment strategies with significant socio-economic impact. To remain computationally manageable, however, such planning models compromise on the level of complexity with which power system operations and physics are captured. A common approach in most planning models is to collapse multi-stage power system operational processes into a single stage and, as a result, give up on the ability to account for uncertainty in each operational stage.
